description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between reliability score and cost for two different ensemble models: a 3-Model Ensemble and a 2-Model Ensemble, as evaluated in the study "PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024: Improving Reliability of SQL Generation using Ensemble LLMs." The x-axis, labeled "Cost," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," is also a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. The blue line, representing the 3-Model Ensemble, starts at a reliability score of approximately 77 when the cost is 0 and shows a steady decline, ending at a score of about 73 when the cost is 10. The red line, representing the 2-Model Ensemble, begins at a reliability score of approximately 77 at a cost of 0 and also decreases, ending at a score of about 72 at a cost of 10. The yellow line, which represents a third, unnamed model, starts at a reliability score of approximately 89 when the cost is 0, declines sharply to a score of about 67 at a cost of 5, and continues to decrease to a score of approximately 35 at a cost of 10. All three lines exhibit a downward trend, indicating that reliability score decreases as cost increases.
